thread:
sam (partnerships): putting this here so we have a single thread for the SI certification plan. goal = low-friction badge + reproducible lab + lightweight runbook review. thoughts?
lei_solutions: prefer two quick tiers: 'Integrate' (1-hr lab pass) and 'Certified SI' (lab + runbook + reference). badge lifetime = 12 months.
omar_eng: agree. lab should be runnable on Dedicated or Private with ephemeral creds. we should provide a terraform skeleton, `provision_lab.sh`, and `cleanup.sh`. include a smoke test that validates an inference roundtrip.
rachel_marketing: for marketplace tile we need a 50-75 char blurb and a single Console screenshot. can eng give a sanitized metrics screenshot?
diego_hw: hardware side: we'll publish a 1-page compat matrix and a tiny perf suite (p95 @ 512 tokens, throughput at batch sizes 1/4/16). partners who validate get a vendor badge.
legal-bot: Suggested marketplace blurb (non-binding): "PartnerName + Redwood: integrated LLM inference with enterprise controls and predictable latency. See docs for SLAs & data residency."
lei_solutions: pass criteria proposal: lab deploys sample model, 5 successful inference calls, smoke tests pass, and a short 10-question quiz (70% pass).
omar_eng: add automated checks: CI runs smoke tests and verifies Console traces for tokens consumed. will include `validate_gpu.sh` for driver/CUDA checks.
sam (partnerships): timeline: drafts due in 72h, internal review next Mon, pilot with 1 partner week after. volunteers to own docs?
lei_solutions: i'll draft the playbook + quiz.
omar_eng: i'll push the repo skeleton and smoke tests.
rachel_marketing: i'll mock the tile + 1-pager and prep badge artwork.
diego_hw: i'll produce the compat matrix and perf vectors.
sam (partnerships): final note: keep cert minimal to reduce onboarding friction. we'll route renewals yearly or after major infra changes. i'll open a GH issue to track tasks. thanks all :raised_hands:
